chunks: O my people, who will save me from God if I drive them away? Do you not understand?
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Hud say about driving away the believers?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Hud (peace be upon him) poses a rhetorical question to his people, highlighting the fragility of his own standing before God if he were to expel the righteous believers from their midst. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the interdependence of leadership and the community's piety, where the leader's accountability is tied to the presence and acceptance of the faithful. It serves as a profound reminder that true leadership requires nurturing the righteous, as their expulsion would leave the leader vulnerable to divine retribution.
